values.note: Daily rates for up to 4 people (children 15 and under free): electric $35, water and electric $40, sewer/water/electric $45; rustic $25; dump station only $20. The page carries no year, but the Wayback Machine shows these rates replaced the 2025 ones ($32/$35/$40) between November 2025 and April 2026, so they are the 2026 rates.

fees.source: https://www.vagabondresort.com/campground--fishing.html ('CAMPING RATES: DAILY Rustic $25 Electric Hookup $35 Water & Electric $40 Sewer, Water & Electric $45 ... Based on up to 4 occupancy'), read 2026-10-22; dated by the Wayback captures of 2025-11-09 (old rates) and 2026-04-18 (these rates)

hookups.source: https://www.vagabondresort.com/campground--fishing.html ('30 amp Full Hook-Ups'; rates for Electric, Water & Electric, Sewer Water & Electric sites), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.vagabondresort.com/campground--fishing.html ('Modern Restrooms', 'Shower House', 'Washer & Dryer on Site', 'Sanitary Disposal Station & Fresh Water Fill Station'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.vagabondresort.com/ ('FOUR SEASON FUN'; cabins have 'gas heat for year-round comfort'), read 2026-10-22. Nothing on the site says the campground itself is open year-round; the stored year_round: true was read from note prose ('Four-season resort') and is cleared.

note: Resort (under new ownership) on 20+ acres by Little Bay de Noc near Rapid River, 15 miles north of Escanaba; rustic cabins plus shaded campsites for tents, trailers and RVs, a playground and a fishing dock. --Claude
summary: Operator site is live over https (http redirects) and current: rates electric $35 / W-E $40 / full hookup $45 for up to 4 (rustic $25), dated to 2026 by the Wayback Machine (raised from $32/$35/$40 between Nov 2025 and Apr 2026). Added 30-amp full hookups, showers/flush toilets/dump/water fill/laundry. Cleared the derived year_round: true (only the resort and cabins are said to be four-season). No booking engine; phone (906) 474-6122 matches. Note cleaned of rates and the RV Life line.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: entry is 'not waterfront', but the operator advertises 'the breathtaking beauty and tranquility of Bay De Noc's sunsets' and a fishing dock ('our new dock improvements'), and the note puts it 'along the east shore of Little Bay de Noc'. The site does not say whether any campsite is on the water.
Website is plain http (http://www.vagabondresort.com/), which now redirects to https://www.vagabondresort.com/: give the https URL.
